description: 市民バス・コミュニティバス [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 町田市. 【町田市】町田市民バス「まちっこ」、町田市コミュニティバス、小山田桜台・多摩南部地域間運行小型バスの停留所一覧です。 提供する情報は2019年10月8日のものです。 本データは、地図作成上の誤差を含んでいます。 また、データ上の表示と現況とは異なる場合があります。. Coverage: 町田市. The portal files it under the publisher 町田市. It offers 7 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
